records.verificationNote: Read from PDL page 2 (NSAIDs). Meloxicam tablet (generic for Mobic) is Preferred and is the most commonly prescribed oral NSAID in the class. Strength and sig are standard label dosing. The PDL lists combination NSAID products as step-only on celecoxib.

records.verificationNote: PDF p.53 (printed p.45): naproxen tablet 250, 375 mg and 500 mg (Naprosyn) Tier 1, no flags; ibuprofen 400, 600, 800 mg Tier 1, no flags; meloxicam 7.5, 15 mg Tier 1, no flags; ketoprofen ER Tier 3, RA flag. PDF p.52 (printed p.44): celecoxib, diclofenac sodium DR, etodolac Tier 1, no flags. PDF p.53: flurbiprofen Tier 3, no flags; ketorolac 10 mg Tier 1, QL flag only. records.verificationNote: Read directly from the UnitedHealthcare 2026 PDL, effective January 1, 2026, page 8 (Analgesics - Drugs for Pain and Inflammation). Confirmed: 'meloxicam oral tablet 1', 'naproxen oral tablet 1', 'naproxen oral tablet delayed release 1', 'ibuprofen oral tablet 400 mg, 600 mg, 800 mg 1', 'diclofenac sodium oral 1', 'nabumetone oral 1', 'sulindac oral 1', 'indomethacin oral capsule 1', 'ketorolac tromethamine oral 1', 'ec-naproxen 1' -- all Tier 1. Confirmed Tier 2: 'celecoxib oral 2', 'naproxen sodium oral tablet 275 mg, 550 mg 2', 'etodolac 2', 'oxaprozin oral tablet 2', 'piroxicam oral 2', 'indomethacin er 2', 'diclofenac potassium oral tablet 50 mg 2'. Confirmed PA/exclusion-flagged ('E'): 'CELEBREX E', 'NAPROSYN E', 'ANAPROX DS E', 'LODINE E', 'RELAFEN DS E', 'diclofenac potassium oral tablet 25 mg E QL', 'LOFENA E QL', 'ibuprofen oral suspension 100 mg/5ml E'. Confirmed Tier 3/4 non-preferred: 'diclofenac sodium er 3', 'diclofenac-misoprostol 3', 'EC-NAPROSYN ORAL TABLET DELAYED RELEASE 375 MG 3', 'EC-NAPROSYN ORAL TABLET DELAYED RELEASE 500 MG 4', 'DAYPRO 4', 'FELDENE ORAL CAPSULE 20 MG 4'. This class is entirely generic-dominated with no PA/step therapy on any Tier 1/2 generic -- consistent with oral NSAIDs being OTC-adjacent, low-cost first-line agents. Sig reflects standard meloxicam FDA-label dosing, not stated verbatim in the PDL. [Reused: same national UHC commercial PDL as the MD guide (2026-10-21); outside CT/NJ/NY its 'E' symbol means may be excluded]

preferredAgent.plainSig: A once-a-day pill for joint and muscle pain and swelling.

records.verificationNote: Read pages 11 and 12: meloxicam 7.5 mg (QL 60 per 30 days) and 15 mg (QL 30 per 30 days), Tier 1, no PA/ST; naproxen, ibuprofen, nabumetone at Tier 1 with no UM. Meloxicam 15 mg picked as a commonly prescribed Tier 1 no-PA agent; the document does not mark it preferred. Oral ketorolac (Tier 4, QL 20) and etodolac (Tier 3) are not picked. Topical diclofenac gel (page 53, PA) is outside the oral class. Sig is standard label dosing. [Reused: same national Humana Premier Rx PDP formulary as the TX guide (2026-10-21)]
